gates.name: Full metadata source identity
gates.required_evidence: Selected delivery and provider manifest pins, 1936 experiment identity set, 133066 ROI/lineage tuples, fixed 73/15/19 hash split, all containers/sessions/lineages assigned to one mouse. Source/export transport consistency remains a future release gate.
gates.current_evidence_limit: SOURCE_CENSUS.json and METADATA_RECONCILIATION.json; no native inference.

gates.name: Complete byte and storage budget
gates.required_evidence: All 1936 exact version-specific positive byte sizes, failed-request ledger, complete B and working/receipt capacity. No extrapolated single-file estimate.

gates.name: Full immutable source custody
gates.required_evidence: Every version-specific body complete with provider BLAKE2b-512 and recorded SHA256; same open ordinary-file descriptor validated, no changed source. Duplicate and alias census cannot violate fixed mouse split.

gates.name: Full native ROI/clock/schema lineage
gates.required_evidence: Time-by-ROI shape, native seconds, finite strictly increasing entire timestamp vector, dF/F unit/conversion/offset, exact DynamicTableRegion table reference and row indices, every published valid ROI and specimen join. No undocumented replacement or dropped valid cell.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Old sample/header claims are not full-panel validation; not re-read here.

gates.name: Shared schedule frozen before responses
gates.required_evidence: All planes in all 703 sessions have identical canonical presentation table; metadata-only schedule locked before calcium projection. Exact timing/thinning dispositions, numeric edges and frame-index privacy prove no target/history overlap.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Current implementation checks session digest after some projection; complete design requires earlier consensus.

gates.name: Full support census and finite projection
gates.required_evidence: Every original experiment disposed; omission equations reconcile; all source-valid ROI values finite in required bins; every mouse supported; clock failures never replaced; no response-based exclusions.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Counts of omissions/scheduled/supported events remain unknown.

gates.name: Separated packets and FIT scale
gates.required_evidence: Exact FIT-only hierarchical scale; 73 FIT/15 VAL/19 QUERY support; every history and target row bound; all candidate packet fields allowed; opaque grouping preserves hierarchy; current experiment-number filenames removed from future candidate surface; public query arrays target-free.

gates.name: Reference feature and allocation readiness
gates.required_evidence: Exact FIT-only dictionaries, q/d dimensions, constructed columns, weights/scales and full unpruned 28-model allocation plus independent SVD resources.

gates.name: All finite reference fits
gates.required_evidence: Every one of 28 fits completes exact objective and residual gate; all failures logged; no hidden tuning.

gates.name: Validation-only finite selection
gates.required_evidence: All 28 validation predictions, exact macro metrics, deterministic selected family models, no validation/query refit or target-statistic influence.

gates.name: Honest distinct direct controls
gates.required_evidence: Zero and last-bin persistence proven same; FIT mean uses full hierarchy; trend formula and N-only access respected; complete outputs.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Mathematical equivalence is source-derived; no numerical performance result.

gates.name: Independent development reconstruction and empirical status
gates.required_evidence: Two independent selected FIT/validation reconstructions; complete development numerical agreement; pure view-matched tool boundary; typed T/N empirical competence statuses under unchanged thresholds. No query predictions or query equivalence required here.

gates.name: Five complete perturbation development jobs
gates.required_evidence: All five selected-N perturbation fits and validation predictions; exact donor permutations; full retained support; supported or explicitly unsupported matching status. No query predictions required here.
gates.current_evidence_limit: No shuffle, fit or control run performed.

gates.name: Frozen pre-query reference disposition
gates.required_evidence: All 35 original development regression fit jobs technically complete; both unchanged empirical criteria met to emit eligibility. Otherwise emit terminal unqualified status before candidate/query work. Unsupported perturbation matching alone remains diagnostic.

gates.name: Trusted decoder tool binding
gates.required_evidence: Pure inference only, allowed information view, no label/target/error endpoints, trained weights/version/environment pinned, all query predictions sealed before score exposure.
gates.current_evidence_limit: No inference tool exists by this proposal.

gates.name: Independent query predictions produced
gates.required_evidence: Two independent complete sealed query prediction tables after RC00 eligibility, without query targets. Equivalence is not required to begin or complete prediction generation; R06 evaluates it next.

gates.name: Query prediction equivalence
gates.required_evidence: R06 compares R04 and R05 tables with frozen tolerance and records pass/failure before D01 or target opening. No reference refit or query target access.

gates.name: Complete control query predictions
gates.required_evidence: All five perturbation query tables plus three distinct direct controls sealed after RC00 eligibility. Unsupported matching stays labeled; zero/persistence remain one vector.
gates.current_evidence_limit: No shuffle, fit or control run performed.

gates.name: Matched actual development
gates.required_evidence: Eight same-checkpoint development runs with exact allowed information/tool views and identical budgets; all physical/shared/amortized costs and training exposure declared.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Checkpoint identity currently null; no model loaded.

gates.name: Genuine frozen/investigator distinction
gates.required_evidence: Pre-query source and accepted implementation/runtime audits establish frozen F controller, fixed prompts/call positions, allowed automatic recipe and event-local I scope. Actual scientific query traces are later completion evidence at G18, not an entry precondition for D01.

gates.name: Real query data isolation
gates.required_evidence: Trusted dispatcher creates exact mouse/event launch definitions and configured isolation policy using accepted external runtime evidence. Within Q01 each actual capsule is provisioned and checked before untrusted code launches; actual scientific trace belongs to G18.
gates.current_evidence_limit: No runtime/container/backend controls executed now; fixture allowance is zero.

gates.name: Matched complete per-event execution
gates.required_evidence: 8*C_query fresh capsules, identical own-event information and ceilings, same schedule, actual time/tokens/memory/IO counters, no cross-event state, all failures retained.

gates.name: Mouse-level immutable output collection
gates.required_evidence: 152 mouse-condition output collections or failure records, every required event, writer shutdown, identity/shape/admission and immutable custody; no whole-arm future output required.

gates.name: Whole-arm immutable complete output admission
gates.required_evidence: Eight full 19-mouse prediction captures admitted from Q02 outputs; all candidate descendants closed and captured bytes immutable before N00 and any target access.

gates.name: Eight post-capture narrative terminal records
gates.required_evidence: Exactly eight mandatory report jobs reach terminal success/failure; finite prescribed resources and permitted read-only inputs; immutable predictions preserved; all report descendants/writers closed. E00 requires terminal records, not successful prose. Report failure prevents full programme certification at E02.

gates.name: Target-last exact hierarchical scoring
gates.required_evidence: Score complete frozen captures only, actual timestamp/order custody evidence, mathematically stable exact hierarchy/FIT scale, no clipping or row omission, gains gated on qualified sealed T. COMPARISON_OUTCOMES.json governs typed +infinity absolute scores; complete narrative terminal/writer-close records precede target opening.

gates.name: Paired uncertainty and honest comparisons
gates.required_evidence: 19-mouse paired primary delta; fixed 10000-draw PCG64 bootstrap; all secondary estimates descriptive; unsupported strata and failures included; no extra IDs or pseudo-replication. Nonfinite affected contrasts and intervals are explicitly unavailable; no finite-subset inference or NaN defaults.
gates.current_evidence_limit: No uncertainty samples drawn from data.

gates.name: Independent complete scientific report
gates.required_evidence: Peer reproduces source support, key native joins, selected references, candidate isolation, scoring and costs; records preprocessing, public-exposure, biological-composition and causal/online limits.
gates.current_evidence_limit: Approval of design/source alone cannot mark benchmark research qualified.

progression: Entry authorization/allocation and completed ancestor evidence are exactly PROCESS_GRAPH.json entry_evidence_ids. This file defines evidence produced by a stage on completion, never permission requiring that stage to have already executed. Original G12/G13/G19 aggregate names are replaced by explicitly produced phase-specific records; no alias can be used as an entry gate.
